prompt:
Cinematic fine-art still for Japanese kanji study ambient video. Keyword concept: I (吾).

Scene: A solitary traveler from behind then slight turn showing face, standing at the edge of a wide misty field — selfhood as witness.

Art direction system: lesson_visual_styles_v1
Style family: KML-WASH
Lesson palette: pale ivory, soft grey-blue, faint ochre
Emotional tone: quiet dawn of literacy
Dominant lesson style treatment. 

Composition: single focal subject, generous negative space, mobile-safe center weight
Lighting: soft dawn sidelight, low contrast, pale luminous haze
Atmosphere: quiet foundational stillness, gentle invitation
Human presence: none unless keyword requires; if present, small in frame with visible face
Symbolic treatment: abstract forms, lines, openings, elemental symbols over literal illustration
Camera distance: medium-wide cinematic
Surface/texture: watercolor wash, soft paper grain, restrained brush edges

KML-NOIR alignment: muted shadows, no crushed blacks, contemplative rather than thriller
Lesson family mood: warm_foundational, quiet dawn of literacy, foundational imagery.

Requirements:
- 16:9 cinematic framing, exhibition-quality atmosphere
- Immediate visual recognition of "I" through symbolism, not literal clipart
- Beautiful, moody, painterly-cinematic — never stock photo
- No text, labels, captions, diagrams, watermarks, or educational overlays
- No UI elements. No English words.
- If humans appear, faces must be visible and natural (not faceless mannequins)
- Optional: subtle integrated sculptural kanji 吾 as environmental light/form (not flat typography)
- Suitable for Ambient Study background, exhibition loop, website gallery
